description: This file contains functions for assigning attribute values to users in bulk within an organization, including building database queries, handling attribute options, and managing existing assignments.

methods.name: findAttributesByName
methods.description: Fetches attributes by name for a given organization, including options with labels.

methods.name: lookupByLabels
methods.description: Creates a map of labels to items, case-insensitive.

methods.name: lookupByLabel
methods.description: Finds a single item by label from a list, case-insensitive.

methods.name: buildPrismaQueriesForAttributeOptionToUser
methods.description: Builds Prisma database queries for creating, updating, or deleting attribute options for a user.

methods.name: buildPrismaQueryForAttributeOptionCreation
methods.description: Creates Prisma input for new attribute options to be inserted.

methods.name: createMissingOptionsAndReturnAlongWithExisting
methods.description: Creates attribute options that do not exist yet and returns all options with IDs.

methods.name: buildAttributeOptionsToAssign
methods.description: Prepares attribute options to assign based on label-value mapping and existing attributes.

methods.name: assignValueToUserInOrgBulk
methods.description: Main function to assign attribute values to a user in bulk within an organization, handling existing assignments and database transactions.
